text:
Carla (CSM): Quick heads-up — Klovian renewal execution hit a signer split. Procurement needs a PO, Finance wants the invoice to show a different legal entity, and their in-house approver wants to sign but needs a delegated signatory added. Can we coordinate?

Leo (AE): @Carla thanks. Customer indicated PO could take 7–10 business days. They asked if CC fallback is acceptable for interim charges.

Amanda (Klovian): Hi all — correct on the PO timeline. We can do CC for onboarding fees but exec wants contract signed under Legal Entity A (Klovian US), billing under Entity B (Klovian EU).

Dan (Legal): That split is fine but we need an amendment to the SOW/PSA to list billing entity and responsible payer. Also need delegated signer email for Amanda's approver.

Sam (Billing): If billing entity != contract entity we need a vendor code and VAT id for Entity B. Also request PO to match the exact invoice entity name. If PO missing we can accept CC but it will be processed under the billing contact on file.

Carla (CSM): Action items: 1) Leo to confirm delegated signer email; 2) Amanda to share vendor code + VAT; 3) Dan to draft a 1-paragraph amendment; 4) Sam to confirm invoice template we’ll send. Sound right? :+1:

Leo (AE): I’ll get the delegated signer email now — pinging customer in thread. Amanda, can you confirm approver name + email?

Amanda (Klovian): Approver is Mark Duffy, mark.duffy@klovian.eu. Vendor code will be shared by EOD. VAT ID: EU-VAT-998877.

ops-bot: Reminder created — "Klovian renewal signer split: gather vendor code & amendment" due in 2 business days.

Dan (Legal): Drafted amendment — short clause to add billing entity and delegated signer. Posting redline below: 
```
Amendment: The Master Services Agreement dated 2024-06-01 is amended to reflect that Invoices may be issued to Klovian EU (VAT ID EU-VAT-998877). Klovian EU is responsible for payment obligations under such invoices. Delegated signer Mark Duffy (mark.duffy@klovian.eu) is authorized to execute non-monetary amendments on behalf of Klovian EU.
```

Sam (Billing): OK. Once we get the vendor code I’ll update our invoice migration template and confirm whether we can map PO# to Entity B. If PO shows Entity A we will need a cross-ref note.

Carla (CSM): Customer asked if we can pre-sign SOW and wait on PO to avoid blocking provisioning. Is that acceptable from Legal/Billing?

Dan (Legal): Pre-sign is OK if amendment and delegated signer are in place, and we include a payment method fallback clause (CC fallback) for onboarding fees.

Sam (Billing): Fine with pre-sign for provisioning if CC authorization is provided and we tag invoices with internal memo: `PO pending - PO# <to be provided>`. We’ll close the reconciliation when PO arrives.

Leo (AE): Amanda — can you provide CC authorization token or contact to set up billing portal temporarily?

Amanda (Klovian): Yes — I’ll send CC auth to Sam via secure portal. Vendor code will come in ~3 hours.

Carla (CSM): Great. Putting checklist here: 
- Delegated signer email (Leo) ✅
- Vendor code & VAT (Amanda) — pending
- Amendment redline (Dan) — in thread
- Billing template + CC fallback (Sam) — pending
- Final SOW for signature (Carla) — will post once Dan confirms redline

Dan (Legal): Redline approved. Carla, please attach to the SOW and indicate digital signature flow (DocuSign).

Carla (CSM): Will do. Draft SOW attached: https://redwood.docs/sows/klovian/172999-draft — please review quickly.

Sam (Billing): Vendor code received (VC-7782). I’ll update invoice entity mapping and send the interim invoice to Mark Duffy once CC auth is received.

Amanda (Klovian): Sent CC auth via portal. Also uploaded PO request — note it lists Entity A; procurement will reissue to Entity B but may take 5 days.

Carla (CSM): OK, next steps timeline: Pre-sign SOW today -> Provision dev access tomorrow -> Invoice interim to CC -> Reconcile when PO arrives (expected +5 days). If anything slips escalate to me.

Leo (AE): On it. I’ll follow up with procurement and confirm when PO is reissued.

Dan (Legal): Note for records — include clause referencing VAT ID EU-VAT-998877; sign delegated signer.

Sam (Billing): Confirmed mapping and interim invoice queued.

Carla (CSM): Thanks everyone. I’ll mark resolved in our tracker and reopen if PO > 7 days. :calendar:
